marco (sdk): quick heads-up: found a class of bugs where editor auto-imports pull CJS paths and users running on edge hit runtime typing and auth regressions.

anya (devex): can you show an example import + package.json exports?

marco (sdk): user code: `import { newClient } from 'redwood-client'` inside a Next edge function. package.json currently: `main=dist/cjs/index.cjs`, `module=dist/esm/index.mjs`, `types=dist/index.d.ts`, exports with import/require but no subpath entries.

rachel (docs): sounds similar to earlier threads but what's novel here?

marco (sdk): two surprises: 1) VSCode auto-import picks the CJS path because our exports lack an explicit edge subpath; 2) when that happens on edge, our auth retry uses setTimeout fallback that leaks because the node timers differ, causing repeated token refreshes.

anya (devex): tl;dr - parity gap between published package layout and edge runtime expectations.

marco (sdk): proposed immediate changes: add "./edge" subpath in exports pointing to an ESM, edge-safe build; include `types` for that subpath; update samples to import from `redwood-client/edge`.

rachel (docs): i'll update quickstart snippets and add a note in the troubleshooting section about editor auto-imports and package exports. Also include a one-liner: "Prefer the /edge entrypoint in edge runtimes."

marco (sdk): implemented a small patch in branch: exports.{".":{import:./dist/esm/index.mjs,require:./dist/cjs/index.cjs,types:./dist/index.d.ts},"./edge":{import:./dist/esm/edge.mjs,types:./dist/edge.d.ts}} and replaced internal retry timers with a Promise.sleep util that supports AbortSignal. Local vercel dev looks green.

build-bot: preview created: https://preview.app/vercel/samples/edge-fix (reaction :white_check_mark:)

anya (devex): can we add a small CI smoke that runs `tsc --noEmit` on the sample and a worker-like runtime smoke (node | worker-polyfill) to catch regressions?

marco (sdk): yes; adding tests and filing meta-issue to capture dual-publish checklist: edge build, exports./edge, types per subpath, runtime-safe utilities, sample CI.

rachel (docs): PR link when ready and i'll add changelog + FAQ blurb.

marco (sdk): filed internal issue #4127 and assigned to platform and docs. thanks all.
